vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: persona-customer-support
Version: 1.0.3

The skill bundle defines a standard customer support persona that utilizes Google Workspace utilities (gws-gmail, gws-sheets, etc.) to manage support tickets. The instructions in SKILL.md are consistent with the stated purpose, and no indicators of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection were found.

llm.summary: The skill's declared dependencies and runtime instructions align with its stated customer-support persona and do not request unrelated credentials or system access, but provenance is unknown and it depends on external 'gws' tooling and helper skills that will handle sensitive auth.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (manage support: triage email, create tasks, update sheets, escalate to chat, schedule calendar) matches the SKILL.md instructions and the declared dependencies (gws binary and gws-gmail, gws-sheets, gws-chat, gws-calendar helper skills). Required binary and helper skills are coherent for Google Workspace-style operations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrowly scoped to running 'gws' commands and invoking the listed utility skills for email triage, sheet appends, chat escalation, and calendar inserts. The SKILL.md does not instruct reading unrelated files, environment variables, or exfiltrating data to external endpoints beyond those services.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files (instruction-only). This is low-risk since nothing is written to disk by the skill itself; it relies on existing 'gws' tooling which must be provided separately.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required env vars or credentials itself, which is proportional. However it depends on other 'gws-*' skills and a 'gws' binary that will likely require Google OAuth credentials/scopes; those credentials are not declared here and should be reviewed in the helper skills before enabling this persona.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and normal autonomous invocation. The skill does not request permanent presence or system-wide config changes; it simply instructs the agent to call helper skills and the 'gws' CLI when invoked.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent for a Google-Workspace-style support persona, but you should verify the provenance of the 'gws' CLI and the helper skills (gws-gmail, gws-sheets, gws-chat, gws-calendar) before installing. Specifically: (1) confirm where the 'gws' binary comes from and that it is trusted; (2) inspect the helper skills to see what OAuth credentials/scopes they request and whether those scopes are limited to mail/sheets/chat/calendar access you expect; (3) prefer installing in an environment/account with least privilege and audit logs enabled; (4) if you require a homepage or author contact for accountability, seek that information since the skill's source/homepage are not provided.
